text.content:
Night Corp frontage on the avenues, brick tenements one alley back.

Region: City Center (district B). Was: Downtown and Little Europe
Controlled by: The NCPD out of Precinct 1, loudly; stop-and-frisk since Whitewater Security lost its contract in 2069
The feel of it: Fake cobblestones, real rents, and the rich and the broke drinking in the same bars
Notable locations: The Bridgehead (#28), the Clock Tower, Night Corp HQ (#24), N54 HQ (#25), 7th Hell (#26), Jinguji (#27), Holy Angels (#29), Short Circuit (#55), Camden Court (#56), Continental Brands (#57)
Danger: Moderate / Corporate. SC 7 (NCPD Precinct 1, Hardened Medium). UC 3

The Chamber of Commerce won its cold war with Little Europe and swallowed it whole. On the broad avenues, Downtown is Corporate in all but name. Step one alley back and you're in old brick tenements, rebuilt "along Western European lines".

Who Lives Here

Little Europe, in the north and west, is still working people, artists, mercs and old families in brick walk-ups, priced out by inches. Downtown proper is media people, mid-level corpos and Plaza workers who want to walk to work. Megabuilding H1 on Morro Rock Blvd is new, half-empty and expensive.

Recent History

  • 2049–2055: Downtown and Little Europe merge after the Purge, and the old club strip of the Eurotrashers and the Bozos is "cleaned up".
  • 2069: Whitewater's contract ends.
  • 2070: The Coronado Bay Bridge lands on Militech's demolition list and bridgehead property crashes. Danger Gal moves into the Bridgehead; Arasaka moves into the Clock Tower.

Places

  • Night Corp HQ (#24). SC 10. A black tower with no logo and no public lobby. The NCART control center is in the basement.
  • Network 54 HQ (#25). SC 9. A sixty-meter screen faces the Spaceport Causeway.
  • Jinguji (#27). SC 8. Designer clothing. A jacket costs a month's rent; a good one costs a car.
  • Holy Angels Church (#29). SC 6. A soup kitchen on Sundays, sanctuary on bad nights.
  • Short Circuit (#55). SC 6. A Little Europe dance club and Mox venue. Nobody sells Black Lace on the floor.
  • Camden Court (#56). SC 7. Brick plaza, cafés and street chess: old Little Europe's living room.

The last Central Loop train leaves Little Europe at two. After that it's Delamains, CombatCabs or walking.

Getting There

NCART: Little Europe, Republic Way, Morro Rock Blvd, Corporation St.

Turf

Neutral. The Mox run a few Little Europe clubs.

People

  • Moira Kavanagh (Fixer 5). 7th Hell's bartender.
  • Pieter "Brick" Van Aart (Solo 4). Ex-Whitewater sergeant who runs a Little Europe neighborhood watch the NCPD hates.
  • Seraphina Lumet (Media 7). Network 54's star anchor.
  • Councilwoman Iris Marchetti (Exec 6). Represents Downtown.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.07
